# La Solution N’style Salon

> Braids, locs & extensions based in Austin, Texas. Knotless braids, cornrows, faux locs, extensions and silk presses by Lea, in her private suite off Hwy 71. Neat, comfortable, never too tight, and a chair that feels like catching up with an old friend.

- Phone: (512) 888-5188
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Oak Hill, Circle C, Sunset Valley, Bee Cave, Dripping Springs
- Google rating: 5.0 from 33 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/la-solution-nstyle-salon/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/la-solution-nstyle-salon/book.html

## Services
- Knotless & boho braids: Neat, even parts and curly boho ends, finished to the length you want.
- Cornrows & kids’ braids: Cornrows that last for weeks, and patient, fun kids’ styles finished with beads.
- Faux locs & loc color: Faux locs, loc styling and bold color, including going from braids to a loc look.
- Extensions & sew-ins: Sew-in, microlink and tape-in extensions, color-matched and blended to your own hair.
- Silk press & styling: Smooth silk presses, soft curls and polished styling for big days.
- Cuts, color & gray blending: Bobs, trims, highlights and gray blending for every age and hair type.

## About
Lea runs La Solution N’style out of Suite 131 at The Marquise Salon Suites on Hwy 71 in Southwest Austin. It is a private suite, so every appointment is one on one: no crowded floor, just you, Lea and the work. She works with all types of natural hair and is known for braids and extensions, and she brings a global work background to every service. Clients come to her for knotless braids, cornrows, faux locs, sew-ins, silk presses, cuts and color, from four-year-olds getting their first beads to festival-goers headed to ACL and Burning Man. Reviewers keep saying the same things: she assesses your hair first, explains your options honestly, is patient and meticulous, and makes a long salon day feel easy, and sometimes even fun.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Where is the salon?
  A: Suite 131 inside The Marquise Salon Suites, 7010 State Hwy 71, Unit 150, Austin, TX 78735, in Southwest Austin near Oak Hill and Circle C.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM, by appointment. Closed Sunday and Monday. Call (512) 888-5188 to book.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Lea works by appointment only, so every client gets her full attention. Call ahead and she will find a time that works.
- Q: How long does a braid or loc appointment take?
  A: It depends on the style, size and length. Big braid and loc styles can be a half-day appointment, so book ahead and Lea will plan the time with you.
- Q: Can you change my style without starting over?
  A: Often, yes. Lea looks at the work you already have and suggests the approach that gets the look you want while keeping what is already done.
- Q: Do you braid kids’ hair?
  A: Yes. Kids’ braids and cornrows, with beads if they want them. Parents say Lea is patient and keeps a long sit fun.
- Q: Will my braids be too tight?
  A: Lea makes sure nothing is too tight anywhere. Clients say they have no pain or headache afterward.
- Q: Is the suite accessible?
  A: Yes. The building has an accessible entrance and accessible parking near the door.
